questions.prompt: Which file has the HIGHEST settings precedence?
questions.explanation: Precedence runs managed > --settings > project local > project shared > user. Managed is highest because your organization can enforce settings you cannot override locally.

questions.prompt: You changed ~/.claude/settings.json but nothing happened. What do you run first?
questions.explanation: /status names which file supplied each value. Nine times in ten the problem is that you edited a layer that lost. Editing the winning layer is faster than guessing.

questions.prompt: What is the recommended maximum length for CLAUDE.md?
questions.explanation: Past 200 lines it stops being instructions and becomes reference material. Move the bulk to a skill and leave a pointer.

questions.prompt: The docs use both 'workspace trust' and 'project trust' for the same mechanism.
questions.explanation: True. Same mechanism, two names in different pages — a rename still settling. If a lesson teaches one name, expect to see the other in the wild.

questions.prompt: What is the reframe this lesson asks you to adopt?
options: The shell is where engineers live
You are choosing which directory an agent may act inside
questions.explanation: Every boundary — permissions, isolation, safety — inherits the working directory you launched in. The directory choice is the first and largest one.
